Name: GRAPHICS_CONFIG_CS_VOLUMETRIC_EFFECT_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Volumetric effect settings (volumetric fog and placeable fog volumes) for each graphics quality level.

Fields.Name: Enable Volumetric Fog Shadows
Fields.Description: If ON, shadows are allowed in volumetric fog.

Fields.Name: Fog Edge Correction Level
Fields.Description: Edge correction level for fog, applied only with bilateral upscaling.

Fields.Name: Fog Volume Resolution
Fields.Description: The processing resolution of placeable fog volumes. (Overrides upscale type setting).

Fields.Name: Fog Shadow Sample Count Offset
Fields.Description: Offset applied to the shadow sample count of volumetric fog.

Fields.Name: Fog: Local Light Distance Scale
Fields.Description: Distance scale for local light calculation in volumetric fog. 0: local lights are not calculated.

Fields.Name: Fog Volume Size Scaler
Fields.Description: Multiplier applied to the fog volume size; used together with Fog Volume Size Divisor.

Fields.Name: Fog Volume Size Divisor
Fields.Description: Divisor applied to the fog volume size; used together with Fog Volume Size Scaler.

Fields.Name: Fog Volume Depth Scaler
Fields.Description: Multiplier applied to the number of depth slices of the fog volume; used together with Fog Volume Depth Divisor.

Fields.Name: Fog Volume Depth Divisor
Fields.Description: Divisor applied to the number of depth slices of the fog volume; used together with Fog Volume Depth Scaler.

Fields.Name: Enable Placeable Fog Volumes
Fields.Description: If ON, placeable fog volumes are enabled.

Fields.Name: Fog Upscaling
Fields.Description: Upscaling type used for fog volumes.

Fields.Name: 2-Step Upscaling
Fields.Description: If ON, upscaling from the reduced buffer is done in two stages instead of one, to reduce flickering.

Fields.Name: Enable Fog Volume Shadow
Fields.Description: If ON, shadows are allowed for placeable fog volumes.

Fields.Name: Fog Volume Ray Sample Count Offset
Fields.Description: The offset applied to the sampling number during ray marching for the fog volume.

Fields.Name: Enable 2-Step Upscaling
Fields.Description: If ON, use 2-step upscaling when applying upscaling to the fog volume.

Fields.Name: Force Fog Volume Shadowing
Fields.Description: If ON and shadows are allowed, the fog volume area always receives shadows regardless of the setting. Shading is not affected.
